name: A Letter to Grelin Whitebeard
summary: A letter from Ironforge reaches Grelin Whitebeard at his camp in Coldridge Valley. The dispatch carries news and instructions to the experienced dwarf on the snowy frontier.

sections.title: A Dispatch from the Mountain
sections.body: Grelin Whitebeard receives word from Ironforge at his wilderness campsite. Coldridge Valley can feel far from the safety of Anvilmar, and letters connect scouts and scholars in the field with the halls of the mountain capital. This missive has traveled south along the mountain paths to reach him.

faq.answer: Grelin Whitebeard is a dwarven scout and explorer camped in southeastern Coldridge Valley. Messengers from Anvilmar bring him news and instructions from Ironforge.

faq.q: Where did this letter come from?
faq.answer: The letter comes from Ironforge, the dwarven capital. A local postal courier carries it through Coldridge Valley and out to the field.

The letter is a short note from King Magni Bronzebeard. He has no time to spare and gives Grelin authority to deal with the trolls as he sees fit, especially if he can find a quick solution. Grelin welcomes the word, since it has been a while since he last heard from Ironforge.

angles.text: As a dwarf, carrying dispatches across Dun Morogh's freezing passes is a basic duty for young mountaineers and recruits hoping to make a name for themselves.
